title: Limit Bands, Over-Limit Reach and Cash Draws across the Northbeam Credit Products
content:
A limit on an account of the Northbeam Store Credit and Financing Accounts range is written inside the band of the product held: not below the smallest limit that product is opened at, and not above the largest limit it is written to.

## Band schedule

| Product | Smallest limit opened at | Largest limit written to | Months on the account before a limit increase is considered | Stated income checked before a limit increase | How far over the limit a draw may still go | Cash draws |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northbeam Store Card | 300.00 | 5000.00 | 6 | yes | 0 per cent of the limit | not available |
| Northbeam Store Card Plus | 750.00 | 12000.00 | 6 | yes | 5 per cent of the limit | not available |
| Northbeam Signature Rewards Card | 2000.00 | 35000.00 | 4 | yes | 10 per cent of the limit | available |
| Northbeam Deferred Interest Promotion Account | 500.00 | 15000.00 | 12 | yes | 0 per cent of the limit | not available |
| Northbeam Business Net Thirty Account | 2500.00 | 50000.00 | 6 | no | 10 per cent of the limit | not available |
| Northbeam Business Fleet Line of Credit | 25000.00 | 500000.00 | 12 | no | 15 per cent of the limit | not available |

All figures are US dollars.

## Reading the schedule

The first two columns are the two ends of the band a limit may be written inside. The third is the number of months on the account before a limit increase is considered, and the fourth says whether stated income must be checked before that increase. The fifth is the over-limit reach: how far past the limit a transaction may still go, expressed as a percentage of the limit. The last says whether cash may be drawn on the account at all.

## Worked reach, on a hypothetical limit

Take a limit of 1000.00 on a product whose over-limit reach is 5 per cent of the limit. Five per cent of 1000.00 is 50.00, so the reach extends to 1050.00 and no further. On the same hypothetical limit under a product whose reach is 15 per cent, the reach extends to 1150.00. Where a product's reach is 0 per cent of the limit, the limit itself is the furthest a draw goes, since nothing is added to it.

The limit of 1000.00 is a hypothetical figure chosen to work the percentages through; it is not a figure any product in the range sets.
